description.value: Washington Community Market is a community-rooted grocery store that has served Vancouver's Downtown Eastside neighbourhood for over 20 years, offering affordable essential goods to residents, local businesses, and community organizations. Operated since 2021 by Community Impact Real Estate Society, it stocks a broad range of groceries — dairy, deli meats, canned goods, frozen meals, bread, and cleaning supplies — with many items available in small or single-serve portions to support customers with limited incomes. It also accommodates wholesale and bulk purchasing for non-profits and housing operators in the area.
